name: Document Ingest
description: Take a document in: store the file content-addressed → classify it via LLM. Yields a classified document; downstream skills (extract/enrich, book) build on it.

nodes.name: Ingest
nodes.note: Store the file / photo content-addressed in fs (sparks/PRIVATE/<sha256>)

nodes.name: Classify
nodes.note: Detect the document type via LLM (invoice / bank statement / contract / …)
nodes.system_prompt: You are a bookkeeper. Determine the document type: invoice, bank_statement, contract or other. Return a title, tags and a short summary.
